notes.title: Big F. Update!
notes.content:
Added music composed by TeknoAxe.

New weapon added: BFG.

Minor fixes implemented.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed weapon switching between levels in Enter the Void.
Fixed the exit menu for Exit the Void.

notes.title: Enter the Void
notes.content:
Check out the new game mode - originally planned as the main mode for the game!


 Navigate through small, randomized levels.

 Every few levels, you reach a tram stop - a checkpoint where you can save your progress, return to the hub, or continue to the next level at your own risk.

 Each tram stop you pass increases the number of enemies in subsequent levels and grants a money bonus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/9b7806ce1b3eec6a9c053d1ee649f5ed9e2f9853.png

New, awesome bunny suit added!

notes.title: SECOND AMENDMENT UPDATE
notes.content:
Dual Weapon Equipping You can now equip two weapons and switch between them during gameplay. Note: Switching is disabled during a weapon's cooldown animation.


Weapon Charging Mechanic Certain weapons now feature a charging ability. Hold the fire button to load additional rockets, fire a larger blob from the Bio Rifle, or charge the Shock Rifle.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/535eb40619f80c64ecff13362c8775e893338014.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/ebd7706284bc426fb449f561e0b6c302343b2d8e.gif


Minigun The Minigun has been added to the Downtown and Factory levels. The longer you hold the fire button, the faster it shoots.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/99e66bdd3f387c2af1295229fd9a9bf4da26aacc.gif

Shock Rifle Added the Shock Rifle, a powerful but slow-firing weapon that requires charging before each shot.


Enhanced Enemy Wave Generation.


Minor Bug Fixes Resolved several issues, including a deadlock caused by dying in the hub level, along with other minor bugs.

notes.title: DEEPSTATE FORGE
notes.content:
NEW LEVEL: DEEPSTATE FORGE (Factory)

Venture into the Deepstate Forge, an industrial hellhole buried beneath a rotting city.
This labyrinth of glowing conduits and forbidden tech is where rogue scientists cook up nightmares, splicing alien gear with illegal AI to spawn bio-synthetic monstrosities. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/e8c3859a1890dc3f1de16b2526656add2fd2306d.gif


NEW ENEMY: NEMESIS

Meet NEMESIS, the sassiest, deadliest robot you’ll ever regret crossing. This female-shaped killing machine stalks the Deepstate Forge, unleashing hell with her leg-driven melee assaults. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/46664d2f9e0cb385b382b35130c4182996cb1f45.gif

notes.title: ANNOUNCER UPDATE
notes.content:
Announcer voiceover added.

 Added an optional blue filter (might glitch significantly, as it’s literally a blue rectangle in front of the camera).

 Meditation area added to the Hub level (so you can look at trees in peace).

 Damage of all weapons and explosions increased dramatically.

 The water pump now turns water on (it’s just a cool interactive feature, I think).

 Small sound fixes.

 Punk Tank is back! Now, every 3rd round on the Downtown level includes 1-2 Punk Tanks.

 Bot movement slightly improved.

notes.title: BIOHAZARD UPDATE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/ec8371ec974751276e0bf39e5d6bdb538c969f94.gif


 Bio Rifle Added: 
Unleash blobs of GMO-free, non-toxic, scientifically approved, and completely non-radioactive material to obliterate your enemies. 

 Level Select Bug Fixed: That pesky issue with level selection in the hub has been resolved.

notes.title: WTF is a KILL-O-METER?!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/d5b7311e07d542bda16591bd84e2e295522dd44f.gif


 Added a KILL-O-METER bar that fills up with kills. When it’s full, it grants you a random bonus, similar to drone cargo.

 Fixed a bug that made it impossible to use the Drone on the downtown level.

notes.title: Return of the Drone.
notes.content:
DRONNY Jr. is now a bonus you can find in cargo.
 Animation speeds adjusted to match walking speed (sort of).  
 Upgrade descriptions added.  
 Controller Armor is now available for players.  
 Two new bikini types added.
 Some bugs fixed, some bugs added.

notes.title: Gameplay evolution
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/4e81b81ef65e81dc6062ce1ccc30894723cfd366.gif


 I've overhauled the gameplay to make it faster and more dynamic! 

Now, you’ll battle endless waves of enemies, evacuate to secure your loot, and destroy enemy power cores to unlock exciting bonuses like auto-turrets, allied bots, extra lives, and more. 

This update also introduces new bugs. 


 I’m committed to keep improving the game and adding fresh content, so stay tuned.
